<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

req-0035 (meadowlark 2026-09-02): pij-rs spawn --harness pi --bin omp returned ok:true; seat pij-cheerful-orlandine stayed idle/proc null and the pane was gone within ~2 min; nothing readable said why (no per-seat spawn log). Dispatch is not delivery. Also known: pij fires false terminal-absence notices on many omp spawns, and omp silently falls back to Opus 5 when its model call fails.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- G1 spawn returns {dispatched:true, bound:false|true, pane, pid} and, unless --no-wait, waits up to N seconds for the seat to register (extension boot ping / /v1/register from that pane) and reports bound or a named failure.
- G2 On a pane that exits before bind: capture the child exit code and the last 20 lines of its output (tmux capture-pane before the window is gone, or a pipe-pane log under ~/.pij-rs/spawn/<spawn_id>.log) and return them in the failure.
- G3 A spine event spawn.bound / spawn.failed with the evidence so it is locatable by seat/spawn id later.
- G4 Fix the false terminal-absence notice if it is the same code path; otherwise record it as a separate finding with file:line.
- G5 A queued delivery for an unbound spawned seat whose pane is absent becomes terminal failed state naming the seat and pane; it is not retried.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Nothing outside the named paths.
